Enjoy exclusive dining privileges at Ootoya & Ootoya Oki when you pay with Bangkok Bank Credit Cards.

# Tier 1: Get 20% discount when spending 500 baht or more per sales slip.

# Tier 2: For Infinite, Platinum credit cards. Get 25% discount when spending 1,000 baht or more per sales slip.
